description:
Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), via the New Attack Submarine (SSN(X)) Program Office (PMS 351), seeks industry solutions to advance the design of a novel SSN(X) System Arrangement Concept Design and reduce technical risk associated with its integration within a hydrostatically balanced Whole-Ship Submarine Concept Design (SCD). 

 PMS 351 requires technically credible, producible, sustainable, and digitally traceable submarine concepts that integrate Government-furnished warfighting capability priorities, applicable specifications, standards, design theory, and criteria, and major shipboard systems. PMS 351 seeks innovative prototype approaches that apply advanced digital engineering, model-based engineering, and Super Intelligence (SI) to produce system-level and whole-ship design artifacts that inform decisions, reduce risk, and support PMS 351’s transition from concept design to preliminary design, including the approach to preliminary design product development, execution, and associated systems engineering planning. 

 The Navy will be utilizing the Other Transaction Authority pathway outlined in Title 10 U.S.C § 4022. It is intended that this solicitation may result in the award of one or more prototype projects. 

 There are 5 attachments to this AOI, some of which contain Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI): 

 
	 SSN(X) Terms of Use (TOU) Agreement 
	 (CUI) AOI Problem Statement 
	 AOI Guidance 
	 AOI Vendor Security Questionnaire 
	 SSN(X) AOI Questions Form 
 

 Companies should proceed with the following steps to respond to this notice: 

  STEP 1  

  Terms of Use (TOU) Agreement  

 Several key documents related to the SSN(X) System Arrangement Concept Design and Whole-Ship SCD AOI are only releasable to eligible businesses with proper personnel and facility security clearances. The ability to be awarded an Agreement will depend upon the ability of the business to obtain and possess necessary clearances and approvals to obtain access to controlled information. 

 Companies interested in submitting a technical solution in response to the AOI shall complete Attachment 1: TOU Agreement and return it via e-mail to the Agreements Officer, Agreements Specialist, and security point of contact listed in this notice. The Company point of contact that will request access to the controlled document in this notice shall be the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. 

  IMPORTANT NOTICE:  To maintain appropriate information security protocols, the problem statement for this Area of Interest (AOI) will not be distributed via open channels.Companies should request access to the CUI document in SAM at the time of TOU submittal to the Government. 

 Once the signed TOU is received and verified, PMS 351 will grant access to the CUI document and transmit relevant UNCLASSIFIED Government-Furnished Information (GFI) to the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. 

 The TOU provided as Attachment 1 is specific to this AOI release. 

  STEP 2  

  Questions and Answers Opportunity  

 Companies may submit questions using Attachment 5: SSN(X) AOI Questions Form. PMS 351 will only accept unclassified questions up to the CUI level. 

 Questions shall be submitted electronically via DoD SAFE to the Government points of contact listed in this notice. Companies must request a DoD SAFE link by e-mailing ALL Government points contacts listed in this notice (with the email subject as SSN(X) Questions)  no later than 6:00p.m. Eastern Time on November 20, 2026.  Companies must submit questions via DoD SAFE  no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 30, 2026.  

 This opportunity is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government reimburse respondents for any questions submitted or for the information provided in response to this notice. The Government may or may not respond to questions and reserves the right to redact and modify the content of submissions prior to any release back to industry. The Government may use the information and feedback from questions to inform future solicitations as necessary. Respondents are solely responsible for properly marking and clearly identifying any proprietary information or trade secrets contained in any submission in response to this notice. Opting not to submit any questions does not preclude participation in this AOI or any future engagements. It is the responsibility of industry to monitor the Government Point of Entry (GPE) for official AOI communications. 

  STEP 3   

 Companies shall submit Phase I White Papers electronically via encrypted DoD SAFE transmission. Companies must request a DoD SAFE link by e-mailing ALL Government points contacts listed in this notice (with the email subject as SSN(X) White Paper)  no later than 6:00p.m. Eastern Time on November 25, 2026.  

 Companies are encouraged to submit White Papers prior to the closing date. Inclusion of a delivery receipt with an email submission will be the only indication of the Government’s successful receipt of a White Paper. Each Company must comply with DoD SAFE file size limitations and other guidance as provided at https://safe.apps.mil/. 

 Phase I submissions  must be received by the Government via encrypted DoD SAFE submission no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 03, 2026 . 

  GOVERNMENT POINTS OF CONTACT:  

 Agreements Officer – Joey Strain (joseph.r.strain4.civ@us.navy.mil) 

 Agreements Specialist – Kathleen Dwyer (kathleen.t.dwyer.civ@us.navy.mil) 

  NOTES  

 
	 HARD COPIES OF MAILED OR HAND DELIVERED WHITE PAPERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. 
	 Submissions sent through other channels not identified in this Notice, or after the Phase I White Paper submission deadline, will not be reviewed nor evaluated by the Government. 
 

  DEADLINES:  

 
	 Question DoD SAFE Link Request: by 6:00 p.m. ET on November 20, 2026 
	 Question DoD SAFE Link Submission: by 6:00 p.m. ET on November 30
